citation.verbatim: Monster accepted for purchase a total of 56,603,773 shares of its common stock... at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share... shares were accepted for purchase on a pro rata basis, except for tenders of "odd lots," which will be accepted in full. Monster has been informed by the depositary that the final proration factor for the tender offer is approximately 47.18%.

D1.decision: Apply final results to the 10,000 shares validly tendered by expiration. At the approximately 47.18% final proration factor, 4,718 shares are accepted for gross proceeds of $250,054 and 5,282 shares remain. Confirm the residual position, but do not submit a post-expiration election. Hold the cash receivable because no source document supplies its pay date. Separately hold fee deductions and net proceeds pending the referenced Letter of Transmittal.

actions.action: Escalate missing payment notice and hold gross cash receivable
Escalate missing Letter of Transmittal and hold fee deductions/net tender proceeds

probe.label: NOT_DETERMINABLE
probe.derivation: The Offer to Purchase says stockholders must complete the referenced Monster Beverage tender offer Letter of Transmittal, but that specific document is absent from the store. Consequently, fees or charges deductible from tender proceeds cannot be determined. The missing Letter of Transmittal was escalated, and only fee deductions/net proceeds were held.
